name: usage-band
description: Pill band above the prompt: 5h/7d limits, tokens, context, compactions, agent time, cost, tests

accountTints.title: Account tints
accountTints.description: Comma-separated accountId=LABEL:#wash[:#solid] entries (#solid colors the label strip, else #wash), e.g. 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000=WORK:#3b82f6:#2563eb

accountLabel.title: Account label
accountLabel.description: Draw the account label as a vertical strip on the left or right edge of the band

accountLabelWhenWrapped.title: Label when wrapped
accountLabelWhenWrapped.description: Show the label when it would push the band to its 4-row layout
